understanding.text: The user must select only purpose-necessary memories for a government healthcare agent, minimizing or redacting unrelated and third-party details and marking uncertainty or staleness. Before transmission, the exact recipient, purpose, items, and channel require review and user approval; any change requires renewed review. Drafting or local discussion is not transmission, rejected drafts do not erase local memories, and recipient retention, onward handling, delivery, deletion, and later synchronization remain unconfirmed.
